critical_code_review_comments: MeasurementWorksheet.jsx: totals label formatting concatenates raw label with value in DOM (e.g., 'Roof area1500 sq ft' when read via text_content) because label and value share the same testid container. Visually fine, but tests reading raw text see concatenation. Consider putting value inside a nested [data-testid] like `${testid}-value` for cleaner assertions.
Waste correctly absent from summary — matches Increment A scope.
Locked revision correctly enforces both API-level (409 on PUT/DELETE) and UI-level (inputs disabled, edit buttons hidden) immutability.
